name: io.github.Bosco-Labs/bosco-labs-data
title: Bosco Labs: official records for AI agents
description: Sanctions, KYB company checks, SEC EDGAR, EU law and more from official sources, each row sourced

tools.name: plan_official_records_query
tools.description: Free, no key needed. Turns a question in plain words into the exact typed Bosco Labs calls that answer it: tool, input, why, and the maximum price of each step, plus what is not covered. Pass the user's question verbatim AND the entities you extracted from it (company_names, tickers, identifiers, countries, dates, law references...): the planner trusts your entities over its own parsing and puts them in the right input fields. The plan echoes them in entities_used and lists in `missing` what to pass for a better plan. Rules and examples first; only when they are unsure and you passed no entities does a small AI step extract the entities (budget-capped, marked `assisted`). Same steps, same plan_id. Run it with run_official_records_plan (paid, max_usd) or call the listed tools directly. Low confidence returns the top 3 candidate tools instead. Questions are kept 30 days in a cut-down form; leave out personal details.

question.description: The user's question, verbatim (EN, NL, DE or FR).
question.title: Question

company_names.description: Companies, with legal form if given, e.g. ["Novo Nordisk A/S"]; also fund managers and hiring companies.
company_names.title: Company Names

person_names.description: People, e.g. ["Nancy Pelosi"] (House members, sanctions targets).
person_names.title: Person Names

countries.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 codes (or English names), e.g. ["DE", "NL"]: the registry country, buyer country, origin of goods or trial location.
countries.title: Countries

identifiers.description: Identifiers by kind, each a list of strings: lei, isin, cik, figi, company_number, kvk, cvr, org_number, nct, cve, ecli, celex, cfr, hs_code, naics, postcode, bag_id, vat, iban, wallet, krs, nip, regon. company_number may carry its country as a prefix: "GB:00445790".
identifiers.title: Identifiers

keywords.description: The topic or search phrase in the user's words, e.g. "cloud hosting", "huurrecht", "non-small cell lung cancer".
keywords.title: Keywords

date_from.description: YYYY-MM-DD, start of the asked period (resolve relative dates).
date_from.title: Date From

date_to.description: YYYY-MM-DD, end of the asked period.
date_to.title: Date To

law.description: A law reference: {"act": "GDPR", "article": "6"} or {"act": "Companies Act 2006", "article": "172", "jurisdiction": "UK"}; jurisdiction EU, UK or NL.
law.title: Law

products.description: Drugs, consumer products or goods, e.g. ["Ozempic"], ["2019 Honda Accord"], ["cotton t-shirt"].
products.title: Products

addresses.description: Dutch addresses as written, e.g. ["Damrak 1 Amsterdam"].
addresses.title: Addresses

amount_min.description: A minimum amount in USD or EUR, e.g. 1000000 for "over $1M".
amount_min.title: Amount Min

entities.description: The same fields as one object (either form works).
entities.title: Entities

tools.name: describe_official_records_tool
tools.description: Free, no key needed. One Bosco Labs tool's full input schema, example input, example rows, output fields, price per row, caps and sources. Use it before calling a tool whose input you are unsure of: the tool list shortens each input field to one sentence, and this shows every field, its allowed values and a working example. Takes the tool name (eu_tenders, or its HTTP slug eu-tenders); an unknown name returns the closest names.

tools.name: lei_lookup
tools.description:
Free, no API token needed. Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) lookup in the official GLEIF
    register: about 2.9 million companies, funds and other legal entities worldwide (source:
    GLEIF API, CC0 open data). Use it to identify a company: its exact legal name, LEI,
    whether it is active, its jurisdiction and country, its local registration number and its
    ultimate parent company.

    Pass an LEI (exact record) or a company name (best matches first; check `legal_name`).

    Returns one row per entity: lei, legal_name, entity_status (ACTIVE/INACTIVE),
    registration_status (ISSUED, LAPSED, ...), jurisdiction, legal_address_country,
    legal_address_city, headquarters_country, registered_as (local registry number),
    ultimate_parent (lei, legal_name; when reported), source_url (the GLEIF record; cite it)
    and next_steps (the paid Bosco Labs call for this company's financials: tool and
    arguments on the remote MCP server and HTTP API, stdio_tool in this package).

query.description: A 20-character LEI, e.g. 724500Y6DUVHQD6OXN27, or a company name, e.g. "Heineken"
query.title: Query

max_results.description: Max companies for a name search (1-5).
max_results.title: Max Results

tools.name: sec_company_lookup
tools.description:
Free, no API token needed. Identify a US-listed (SEC-registered) company: CIK, official
    name, ticker(s), exchange(s), industry (SIC code) and state of incorporation (source: SEC
    EDGAR company tickers file and submissions API). Use it to turn a ticker or name into the
    CIK that SEC tools take, or to check which exchange a stock trades on.

    Pass a ticker, a CIK or part of the name (best matches first, then by company size; check
    `name`). A name search covers companies with a listed ticker (about 10,000); a CIK also
    finds filers without one.

    Returns one row per company: cik, name, tickers, exchanges, sic, sic_description,
    state_of_incorporation, fiscal_year_end (MMDD), source_url (the EDGAR company page; cite
    it) and next_steps (the paid Bosco Labs calls for its filings and insider trades).

query.description: A ticker (AAPL), a CIK (320193) or part of the company name ("apple")
query.title: Query

max_results.description: Max companies for a name search (1-5).
max_results.title: Max Results
